### Goal-Card

Legacy investment-goal card (unpublished) with ROI, currency and progress message texts: covers no-goal CTA with map illustration, goal start, outline variants and in-progress plan states in Arabic and English.

Level: organism · Contains: GoalChart

Use when:
- Reproducing legacy goal screens that need editable ROI or message text
- Reference when migrating to GoalActivate / GoalTracker

Don't use when:
- For new work use GoalActivate before a goal exists and GoalTracker after

Accessibility: CTA button needs a clear label (حدد هدفك). Status wip with no doc page; prefer GoalActivate and GoalTracker (07b CardGoal).

Compliance: Projected plan lines are illustrative; never promise reaching the goal.

> Not published to the Figma library. Use it by name everywhere; in another Figma file take its published route or copy it from the Syntropy file (syntropy-components, unpublished.md).

### Goal card

Legacy goal card with three phases: Begining (map illustration with «حدد هدفك الاستثماري» CTA), Started (investment plan chart, period chips and target), Static.

Level: organism · Contains: GoalChart

Use when:
- Legacy goal entry (Begining) and plan (Started) cards
- Mapping legacy phases onto GoalActivate

Don't use when:
- Use GoalActivate (its phases mirror this Property 1) and GoalTracker

Accessibility: Status wip with no doc page; prefer GoalActivate and GoalTracker (07b CardGoal).

Compliance: Show the comparison with and without investment as projected.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Property 1 | `unnamed1` | variant | Begining, Started, Static | Begining |
| Language | `language` | variant | Arabic, English | Arabic |

### GoalChart

Stepped area chart comparing growth with Safqah investment (green) against without investment (grey) over months.

Level: molecule · Part of: GoalPlan, Goal card, Goal-Card, GoalCard

Use when:
- Inside GoalPlan or Goal card Started
- Showing with and without investment growth paths side by side

Don't use when:
- For general charts use Chart / Area or Chart / Line

Accessibility: Provide a text summary of the two end values; chart is otherwise decorative.

Compliance: Illustrative projection only.

_No properties._

### GoalPlan

Legacy «خطتك الاستثمارية» plan card: chart, period selector (3M to 5Y), with and without investment legend, goal amount and progress chip, and target details link; also begining and static states.

Level: organism · Contains: GoalChart

Use when:
- Legacy goal plan screens with period chips
- Reference for the plan layout when extending GoalTracker

Don't use when:
- For new work use GoalTracker

Accessibility: Period chips act as a radiogroup. Status wip with no doc page; prefer GoalActivate and GoalTracker (07b CardGoal).

Compliance: Projected values; no guarantees.
